headline: KIIRAS cheer on youth with new single 'OVER U'
sub: 2nd digital single and first release in about 6 months
caption:
KIIRAS are back with 'OVER U', their second digital single, and the MV is out now.

The six-member girl group's first release in about six months takes on a cheerleading concept, with a message about getting back up after setbacks and cheering each other on. Watch for the hand-sign point choreography. "We hope 'OVER U' gives strength to anyone going through a tough moment," the group said.

📌 Source: Korean media (JoyNews24, Alpha Economy)
